Thanks, Nanette.

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: mongolian gazelle
parts:
Hi Nanette,

There are two published datasets. The second was analyzed with AKDE here: https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1365-2664.13380
The first was not fully analyzed with AKDE in any publication IIRC, but the data are available to do so: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/gazelle.html

Best,
Chris
